title: Skinwalker Ranch camera dismantled between frames

tellings.quote: And in that uh time frame, somehow somebody cut the wires of that camera and pulled all of the duct tape off the pole.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, retells a story he credits to John Alexander, a researcher of strange phenomena, about Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of odd happenings. According to Jorjani, a camera was taped to a pole, and in the short gap between its pictures someone or something cut its wires and pulled all the duct tape off the pole. If true, it would point to an unseen presence able to act faster than the camera could catch.
